name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Single or multiple accordions on native details, in separated, cards and flush variants: the open item lifts out of the stack on a bouncy spring. CSS-only motion.

.rx-accordion > .rx-accordion-item.background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--_sheen), transparent 40%, transparent 60%, var(--_shade)) padding-box, linear-gradient(var(--_fill), var(--_fill)) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, var(--_edge-a), var(--_edge-b)) border-box
.rx-accordion > .rx-accordion-item.transition: --_fill 150ms var(--motion-ease), margin-block-start var(--_time) var(--_ease), border-radius var(--_time) var(--_ease)
